subject: Pipeline cleanse kickoff — month-end stability checkpoint
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Lori Barnes <lori@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pipeline cleanse kickoff — month-end stability checkpoint

Team — kicking off a short, targeted pipeline cleanse today to get Q3 month-end and Q4 leadership packs in stable shape. Goals: confirm stage ownership and solid commits for leadership review, flag any risked deals for escalation, and produce a clean deck outline.

Action items (please reply inline):
- Each stage owner: update "Committed / Best Case / Pipeline" rows in the attached pipeline_sheet_sep.csv by EOD PT (today, 5pm PT).
- If an opportunity moves out of commit or drops stage, add a one-line rationale in the comments column.
- Karthik: please attach the stage-owner roster and call out any gaps by 11:30am PT.
- Lauren: consolidate top 10 leadership-ready commits into the leadership_deck_outline.md; I'll take deck assembly once I have the list.

We will assemble the leadership pack tomorrow morning for the regional exec readout. If there are procurement/PO constraints with a customer (e.g., Nimbus), flag that now so Procurement can be looped.

Attachments: pipeline_sheet_sep.csv, leadership_deck_outline.md

Thanks — quick cadence here.

— Olga
Olga Petrov
Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Pipeline cleanse kickoff — month-end stability checkpoint

Thanks Olga — on it. Quick clarification: is the commit cut-off the same as our usual finance freeze (EOD PT today), or do you want a hard freeze earlier for the leadership pack? I can do an interim pass at 12:30pm PT if that would help.

Also, I've flagged two Nimbus deals where legal is still looping on a DPA change — I included brief notes in the sheet. Lori, do you have an update on the DPA timing?

— Monica

Attached: stage-owner-list.xlsx — added owner, backup, and a short readiness note for each deal. A couple of quick calls-outs: 
- ACME-2717 (Large): marked as "Best Case" pending PO receipt; finance@acme-corp.com is on payment hold -> flagged for procurement.
- Nimbus-448: Legal DPA in progress; Lori is looped (CC'd above).

I'm comfortable with an interim freeze at 12:30pm PT for an initial leadership list; final commit can be EOD PT. I'll also mark opportunities that need CSM/AE double-confirmation in the comments.

Appreciate the fast turnaround. Summary / next steps: 
- Interim list (12:30pm PT snapshot) will be used to draft the leadership-ready Top 10; final commit snapshot by EOD PT will be used for the official finance numbers.
- Karthik: thanks for the roster — I pulled the stage-owner file into the Drive folder (link below) and added a "deck priority" flag for the top ten.
- Monica: please follow up with Lori on the DPA timing; if DPA doesn't land before Friday, we'll mark Nimbus-448 as "At Risk" for the leadership pack and note the mitigation plan.
- Lauren: plan to deliver the first deck draft by 9am PT tomorrow for exec review.
